# Borghese Gallery

> > The Borghese Gallery in Rome houses one of the world's finest collections of Baroque sculpture by Bernini and Renaissance masterpieces by Caravaggio, Raphael, and Titian.

Located in Villa Borghese, the gallery was founded by Cardinal Scipione Borghese and features iconic works including Bernini's Apollo and Daphne, Caravaggio's religious paintings, and Titian's Sacred and Profane Love. Visitors must book timed entry tickets for 2-hour viewing slots.

## Key Topics

- Gian Lorenzo Bernini sculptures
- Caravaggio paintings
- Raphael Renaissance works
- Titian Venetian masterpieces

- [Tickets Borghese Gallery, Rome](https://borghese.gallery/tickets): Ticket booking, hours (Tue-Sun 9am-7pm), 2-hour timed entry slots

## Bernini Baroque Sculptures

- [Apollo and Daphne by Bernini in the Borghese Gallery, Rome](https://borghese.gallery/collection/sculpture/apollo-and-daphne.html): Bernini's 1622-25 Baroque marble masterpiece of Ovid's metamorphosis
- [Aeneas, Anchises, and Ascanius by Bernini in Borghese Gallery](https://borghese.gallery/collection/sculpture/aeneas-anchises-and-ascanius.html): Early Bernini Baroque sculpture of Aeneas fleeing Troy with family

## Paintings Collection

- [Paintings in Borghese Gallery](https://borghese.gallery/collection/paintings): Paintings collection featuring Caravaggio, Raphael & Renaissance masters
- [Sacred and Profane Love by Titian | Borghese Gallery Rome](https://borghese.gallery/collection/paintings/sacred-and-profane-love.html): Titian's 1514 Venetian allegorical masterpiece for Aurelio wedding
- [Deposition or the Entombment by Raphael | Borghese Gallery](https://borghese.gallery/collection/paintings/deposition-by-raphael.html): Raphael's 1507 Deposition altarpiece (Pala Baglione) from Perugia
- [Portrait of Pope Julius II by Raphael in the Borghese Gallery, Rome](https://borghese.gallery/collection/paintings/portrait-of-pope-julius-ii.html): Raphael's 1511-12 High Renaissance portrait of Pope Julius II
- [John the Baptist by Caravaggio in the Borghese Gallery, Rome](https://borghese.gallery/collection/paintings/john-the-baptist.html): Caravaggio's Baroque depiction of John the Baptist in wilderness
- [Portrait of Pope Paul V by Caravaggio | Borghese Gallery Rome](https://borghese.gallery/collection/paintings/portrait-of-pope-paul-v.html): Caravaggio's 1605-06 papal portrait of Pope Paul V (Camillo Borghese)
- [Sermon of St John Baptist by Veronese in Borghese Gallery, Rome](https://borghese.gallery/collection/paintings/sermon-of-st-john-baptist.html): Veronese's 1562 Venetian oil painting of St John Baptist's sermon
- [Aeneas Fleeing from Troy by Federico Barocci | Borghese Gallery Rome](https://borghese.gallery/collection/paintings/aeneas-fleeing-from-troy.html): Barocci's Baroque painting of Aeneas fleeing Troy in Borghese Collection
- [Portrait of a Man by Parmigianino in Borghese Gallery, Rome](https://borghese.gallery/collection/paintings/portrait-of-a-man-by-parmigianino.html): Parmigianino's 16th-century Renaissance portrait in Room X
- [Portrait of a Man by Antonello da Messina | Borghese Gallery Rome](https://borghese.gallery/collection/paintings/portrait-of-a-man.html): Antonello da Messina's 15th-century oil portrait, Venetian influence

## Artists & Creators

- [Leonardo da Vinci in Borghese Gallery Rome](https://borghese.gallery/creators/leonardo-da-vinci): Renaissance polymath Leonardo da Vinci (1452-1519) in collection
- [Federico Barocci in Borghese Gallery Rome](https://borghese.gallery/creators/federico-barocci): Renaissance painter Federico Barocci (1535-1612) biography & works
- [Perugino in Borghese Gallery Rome](https://borghese.gallery/creators/perugino): Umbrian Renaissance painter Perugino (1446-1523), Raphael's teacher
- [Jacopo Bassano in Borghese Gallery Rome](https://borghese.gallery/creators/jacopo-bassano): Italian painter Jacopo Bassano (1510-1592) biography & Venetian works
- [Francois Duquesnoy in Borghese Gallery Rome](https://borghese.gallery/creators/francois-duquesnoy): Flemish Baroque sculptor Duquesnoy, contemporary of Bernini & Algardi
- [Dosso Dossi in Borghese Gallery Rome](https://borghese.gallery/creators/dosso-dossi): Ferrara School Renaissance painter Dosso Dossi (1489-1542) biography
